rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (already fixed by main agent): salt-spray module defined module-level `async def _analyze_rust(req: RustAnalyzeRequest)` in server.py, which Python's late-binding rebound the symbol used by rust_analyze_start's background job — so Rust analyses were being written to db.salt_tests via the salt helper. Mitigation applied: salt helper renamed to `_analyze_salt`; verified: (1) rust record appears only in /api/rust/tests, (2) GET /api/rust/tests/{id} returns 200 immediately after analyze, (3) salt analyze still produces valid salt records. No further action needed. REPRO STEPS (pre-fix): POST /api/rust/analyze/start → poll /api/rust/analyze/jobs/{id} → record_id → GET /api/rust/tests/{record_id} returns 404 (bug); same id visible in /api/salt-spray/tests. POST-FIX: GET returns 200, record exclusively in rust collection.
